Name: Mushroom Box to Log
Author: trulyvivid
Description:
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23736]﻿[/url]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/5kXH2wf.png[/img]﻿
Does what it says on the tin; this is a simple Content Patcher mod that replaces the sprites for the Mushroom Box (the ones you find in your farm cave if you choose the Mushrooms option) with the sprites for the Mushroom Log craftable released in update 1.6. This is my first mod, so please be kind!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/V2d2HPF.png[/img]﻿[/left][list=1]

[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip Content Patcher's folder into [u]Stardew Valley/Mods[/u].
[*]Unzip Mushroom Box to Log's folder into [u]Stardew Valley/Mods[/u].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[u][/u]

[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/77MnnBE.png[/img]﻿

If I've done everything right, this pack should be compatible with any mod, provided it doesn't also replace the texture for the mushroom box.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jXEJZl9.png[/img]﻿

None yet!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fPCgvl9.png[/img]﻿
